info.title: DOG DATA API
info.description: Comprehensive on-chain analytics API for DOG (Bitcoin Rune 840000:3). Provides real-time holder data, transaction analytics, UTXO metrics, forensic behavioral analysis, airdrop tracking, market data from 20+ exchanges, and Bitcoin network stats. Designed for AI agents and programmatic access.

get.description: Returns total holders, circulating supply, total supply, top 10 holders, and metadata. Falls back to local data if upstream API is unavailable.
Returns a paginated list of DOG holders sorted by rank. Data sourced from the local block scanner (dogdata.xyz).

get.summary: Look up a specific holder by address
get.description: Returns detailed holder information including rank and balance for a given Bitcoin address.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Bitcoin address to look up

404.description: Address not found in holder list

get.description: Returns a snapshot of the top 500 DOG holders with timestamp. Useful for periodic comparisons.
Returns DOG rune transactions from Upstash KV cache or local JSON fallback. Supports summary-only mode.

parameters.name: summary
parameters.description: If set, returns only transaction count and metadata (no full tx list)

get.summary: Search for a specific transaction by txid
get.description: Returns details for a specific DOG rune transaction by its Bitcoin txid.

parameters.name: txid
parameters.description: Bitcoin transaction ID

get.description: Returns bucketed transaction data for heatmap visualization. Supports multiple timeframes and data layers (volume, count, fee, whale, retail). Includes drill-down into individual buckets.

parameters.name: timeframe
parameters.description: Time range for the heatmap grid

parameters.name: layer
parameters.description: Data layer to visualize

parameters.name: drill
parameters.description: Bucket index to drill down into (returns individual transactions for that bucket)

get.summary: Get current DOG price from Kraken
get.description: Returns the current DOG/USD price from Kraken exchange with 24h change, high, low, and volume. Falls back to CoinGecko if Kraken is unavailable.

get.summary: Get DOG price from all tracked exchanges
get.description: Returns DOG price data from all tracked exchanges (Kraken, MEXC, Gate, Bitget, Bitflow, Dogswap) and Solana DEXes (Orca, Raydium, Meteora, Jupiter) for cross-exchange comparison.

get.summary: Get DOG price from a specific exchange
get.description: Returns DOG price from a specific exchange. Supported CEXes: kraken, mexc, gateio, bitget, bitflow, dogswap. Solana DEXes: orca, raydium, meteora, jupiter.

parameters.name: exchange
parameters.description: Exchange identifier

get.description: Returns aggregated on-chain metrics including UTXO distribution, holder concentration, realized cap, and UTXO age data.
Returns time-series data for all on-chain metrics. Supports multiple time ranges and optional metric filtering. Data is downsampled to appropriate bucket sizes per range.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Time range for historical data

parameters.name: metrics
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of metric names to include (e.g., 'gini_coefficient,total_holders')

get.description: Returns UTXO count, average size, and size distribution buckets calculated from individual UTXOs.
Returns UTXO age distribution data including HODL waves, average/median age, and short-term vs long-term holder percentages.

200.description: UTXO age distribution and HODL waves

get.description: Returns Gini coefficient and percentage of supply held by top 10, 100, and 1000 holders.
Returns realized cap, market cap, MVRV ratio, and current price. Realized cap values each UTXO at the price when it was last moved.
Returns the percentage of DOG supply currently in profit vs loss based on the price when each UTXO was created.
Returns paginated forensic profiles with behavior classification. Supports filtering by behavior pattern.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Filter by behavior pattern (e.g., 'diamond_hands', 'active_trader', 'paper_hands')

get.description: Returns aggregate statistics from the behavioral forensic analysis: category breakdown, diamond score averages, and pattern distribution.

get.summary: Get forensic profile for a specific address
get.description: Returns the behavioral forensic profile for a specific Bitcoin address including behavior pattern, diamond score, and transaction metrics.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Bitcoin address

404.description: Address not found in forensic data

get.description: Returns aggregate airdrop analytics including total recipients, retention rate, and category breakdown.
Returns the list of all airdrop recipients with amounts and retention data.

Returns comprehensive Bitcoin network data: difficulty adjustment, hashrate (7d), mempool stats, fee estimates, recent blocks, mining pools, and BTC price. Data sourced from mempool.space and CoinGecko.

get.summary: Get DOG market data from all exchanges
get.description: Returns DOG market tickers from 20+ exchanges (CoinGecko aggregated) plus Bitflow DEX. Includes aggregated market data (price, volume, market cap, 24h change). Data refreshes every 60 seconds.

get.summary: Get DOG holders on Stacks and/or Solana
get.description: Returns top holders of bridged DOG tokens on Stacks (via Tenero) and Solana (via Helius). Includes balances, USD values, holder stats, and concentration percentages. Omit `chain` to get both chains.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Filter by blockchain: stacks or solana. Omit for both.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of top holders to return (default 20)

200.description: Multi-chain holder data with stats and concentration metrics

stacks.description: Stacks holders, stats, and concentration data

get.summary: Get DOG transactions on Stacks and/or Solana
get.description: Returns recent DOG token transactions (transfers and swaps) on Stacks (via Tenero) and Solana (via Helius Enhanced API). Omit `chain` to get both chains. Gracefully degrades if one chain is unavailable.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Filter by blockchain: stacks or solana. Omit for both.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of transactions to return (default 30)

solana.description: Solana DOG token transfers and swaps

get.summary: Aggregated DOG stats across Stacks and Solana
get.description: Returns aggregated statistics for DOG tokens across Stacks and Solana — total holders, market cap, 24h volume, and circulating supply per chain. Uses Tenero (Stacks) and Birdeye (Solana) as data sources.

Returns time-series data of Stacks DOG metrics from Supabase. Captures holder count, price, market cap, volume, concentration (top 10/25/50%), whale wallets, and active/fresh holder counts. Snapshots are taken hourly via Vercel cron.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Lookback window in days (default 30, max 365)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max rows to return (default 720)

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: Set to 'true' for only the most recent snapshot

get.summary: Discover API capabilities for AI agents
get.description: Returns a machine-readable description of all available endpoints, their parameters, rate limits, and authentication requirements. Designed for AI agent auto-discovery.
Returns the complete OpenAPI 3.0.3 specification for this API.
Server-Sent Events stream for real-time DOG transaction and price updates. Connect with EventSource API. Events include new transactions, price changes, and whale alerts.

schema.description:
Server-Sent Events stream. Each event has format: event: <type>
data: <json>

get.description: Returns API health status. Returns 200 if the service is operational.

get.summary: Get large DOG transfers across Bitcoin, Stacks, and Solana
get.description: Returns DOG transactions above the specified threshold across all supported chains (Bitcoin L1, Stacks, Solana). Includes severity classification, USD value, sender/receiver analysis, contextual interpretation, explorer links, and pre-formatted tweet text. Default threshold: 1M DOG. Filter by chain or get alerts from all chains at once.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Filter by blockchain. Omit for all chains.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: Minimum DOG amount to trigger alert (default: 1,000,000)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of alerts to return

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format: full (all fields), tweet (tweet text only), compact (summary)

get.description: Returns detailed status of all subsystems: database connectivity, cache health, external API availability, and data freshness.

Powers the public /status page. Aggregates 90 days of passive observations from system_health_log (Supabase) plus live infra checks (Redis, Supabase pings) and data-freshness probes. Returns per-component status, latency, last-checked timestamp, 30/90-day uptime percentage and per-day rollups for the last 90 days. Cached 30s at the edge.
